text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...*Phew*... haah.
How did my run look just now?
choice_data_list: That was a wonderfully spirited run. ...However,

text_block_list.text:
Lately, her form has been slipping and her lap times have been erratic,
so I advise that we focus on bringing more stability to her runs.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Then let us add further basic training.
We must develop physical conditioning in parallel.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming event was an exhibition race,
drawing distinguished figures from throughout the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In order to demonstrate the strength of our clan to them,
we must eliminate any lingering causes for concern.
choice_data_list: (Is this inconsistency from putting too much pressure on herself to get results?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—Oh?
Has something on the track caught your attention?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I see Rose-san is training late into the evening today as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I've heard about the circumstances, but
it seems to me you're pushing yourself far too hard.
If only there was something I could do to help.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Then it is a simple matter.
That is precisely what we shall do!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—Race support...
from the two of you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Sticking to a familiar menu is fine, but
there is plenty we can learn from other players as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Having all three of us provide support at once would only cause confusion.
It would be best if only one of us assists directly, while the others offer support
through refreshments and cheering on race day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Of course, only if it wouldn't be an inconvenience. ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your consideration.
However――

The abilities of all three are beyond question.
For the sake of the race, let's do everything we can—
I give a supportive push to her hesitant back.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
In order to grasp that glorious crown...
everyone, allow me to rely on you this time.
The choice of personnel Rose Kingdom announced after that was—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I am delighted.
I shall lend my assistance with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Girls Invited by Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"'Ah, hello, Rose-senpai!'
'We'll be giving it everything we've got today!'"

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...?
What on earth are they...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: They are the ones who kindly agreed to assist after I explained the circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
After hearing the race lineup from Ruler-san...
I asked runners with similar styles
to join our mock race.
choice_data_list: To gather such a perfect cast so flawlessly...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
Truly, Pisa's vast network of connections never ceases to amaze me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu. You are part of that connection too, you know, Rose-san?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
We are all connected within the very same circle...
So please, never hesitate to reach out whenever you need aid.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Pisa.
Thanks to this rehearsal, I can face the real thing properly prepared.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—The opportunity you have granted me
shall not be squandered.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I am truly blessed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am honored.
I shall live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: From this point forward, you will execute the schedule I have just provided with absolute precision.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
15:30: Pace running concluded.
Next is thirty minutes of lower-body strength conditioning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
16:00: Cool-down commences.
Once that is complete, we shall proceed to
twenty-five minutes of core training.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
choice_data_list: (Down to the minute and precise... So this is her style.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The time is now 17:30.
That concludes today's training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Flash-senpai, could we extend our session just a bit?
With only this much practice, I can't help feeling unprepared.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If haste causes disruption, everything will fall apart.
What you must do now
is strictly adhere to your designated pace.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah...!
choice_data_list: (Incredible... She's visibly stabilized in just a few days.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Never faltering, executing what must be done to perfection.
...Thanks to Flash-senpai, I feel as though my eyes have been opened.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...But why do you go so far
to lend me your strength?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—...Pardon my presumption.
I simply find myself able to empathize with you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Of course, what Rose-san and I carry on our shoulders is vastly different, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Comrades who each strive toward glory
for the sake of those they cherish, and the pride held deep within their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you work so tirelessly until late into the night each day...
I couldn't help but pray for your victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Flash-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I swear it.
I shall surely bring you good tidings.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I am truly blessed.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, a natural choice.
Leave it to me; I shall deliver the utmost results.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To curb inconsistency and foster stability,
mental training should prove effective.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An unpredictable battle,
a board state near impossible to overturn—
cultivating the composure to calmly navigate such crises—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Train using board games that are heavily RNG-based...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
How about a flower-raising game to fit with Rose?
Be warned, though... take it lightly and you'll end up crying.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Every point you gain or lose is decided purely by the dice, and the events have a ridiculously high game-breaking rate.
And in the middle of all that chaos, you gotta cultivate your ideal flower!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What a shit game!!!!!
My armeria withered from herbicide!!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, hahaha.
To think the rose I cultivated would turn into a Rafflesia.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
Yet, judging by your state, there was indeed progress.
With each repetition, you have grown noticeably calmer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Having weathered violent, turbulent seas time and again, the vital importance of keeping my composure has truly struck home.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...During the real race, I must assess my surroundings
and calmly adapt to the situation.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: You truly are remarkable, Ruler. That training method never would have occurred to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Putting it to good use like that makes you quite something too.
Go right ahead and seize that crown with grace, Your Majesty.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...I am truly blessed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To have someone with whom you can contend for glory at times,
yet join hands with at others...
How truly precious that is.
Seeing that she had classmates willing to lend their aid, and witnessing the undeniable bond between them and my master, brought a deep sense of relief.
